EC1: Anaphylactic reaction to a previous dose of influenza vaccine [OR] or to any of its components
EC2: Known Immunoglobulin E (IgE)-mediated hypersensitivity [AND] to eggs manifested as hives [OR], swelling of the mouth [OR] and throat  [OR], difficulty in breathing [OR], hypotension [OR], or shock
EC3: Guillain- Barré syndrome within eight weeks of a previous influenza vaccine
EC4: Use of aspirin [OR] or salicylate- containing products within 30 days before enrollment
EC5: Household members of children in Group A
